title: The 7‑Year‑Old Mystery of Canada’s Spotted Lake

scenes.text: 7‑year‑old lake that bursts into rainbow spots

scenes.query2: drone footage of Khiluk lake color spots

scenes.text: In summer, over 30 mineral‑rich pools dry, leaving vivid pink, green and yellow spots.

scenes.query2: macro shot of pink green yellow spots Khiluk

scenes.text: The lake’s water is 10 times saltier than the ocean, making it too toxic for most life.

scenes.query2: crystalline salt crust on Spotted Lake

scenes.text: It’s not a natural painting – the spots are mineral crusts that form when the lake evaporates.

description: Spotted Lake in British Columbia looks like a giant watercolor palette when the summer sun draws out its mineral colors. Discover why this toxic lake turns into a living artwork.
